description: Answer a question by quoting a published wiki article, or — when the question names one country, programme, tax regime, bank or legal form and asks one of its reviewed questions — with the reviewed structured answer and its verbatim official quotation. Never generated at request time; always carries the URL it came from. Returns confident=false with suggested reading when the corpus does not cover the question or when context genuinely conflicts. Bare MSO means the Hong Kong Money Service Operator licence; use Management Services Organization or regulated-practice context for the broader platform concept. Ask in the language you want answered — Russian and English are both first-class.

locale.description: Corpus language; inferred from the question when omitted.

question.description: A natural-language question, up to 2000 characters.
